question: 사단법인 지부 회원 중 공통브랜드별 평균 증액확률, 회원 100명 이상만
result:
The question is clear and I can answer it with the following SQL.

Generated SQL (ensure the -- Generated by Cortex Analyst comment is included when executing the SQL):
```sql
WITH __pa AS (
  SELECT
    cmmn_brnd_nm,
    cpr_div_nm,
    hq_branch_nm,
    mber_no,
    stdr_mt,
    inc_prob
  FROM GN_DW.SERVING.ML_MEMBER_PRED_AXIS_V
), latest_mt AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(pa.stdr_mt) AS max_mt
  FROM __pa AS pa
), filtered AS (
  SELECT
    pa.cmmn_brnd_nm,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pa.mber_no) AS member_cnt,
    AVG(pa.inc_prob) AS avg_inc_prob
  FROM __pa AS pa
  JOIN latest_mt
    ON pa.stdr_mt = latest_mt.max_mt
  WHERE
    pa.cpr_div_nm = '사단' AND pa.hq_branch_nm = '지부' AND NOT pa.cmmn_brnd_nm IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    pa.cmmn_brnd_nm
)
SELECT
  f.cmmn_brnd_nm AS "공통브랜드",
  f.member_cnt AS "회원수(명)",
  f.avg_inc_prob AS "평균 증액확률"
FROM filtered AS f
WHERE
  f.member_cnt >= 100
ORDER BY
  f.avg_inc_prob DESC NULLS LAST
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: 026be1c6-509a-4de8-975b-6febe71c9a76)
;
```
